Background

I'm a multidisciplinary graphic designer based in Budapest, transforming ideas into visual identities that combine aesthetics with purpose.

My work focuses on branding, packaging, editorial layouts, and digital design — always balancing creativity with functionality.

I believe design should communicate before it decorates. It should be clear, intentional, and timeless.

When I'm not designing, you can find me exploring art, photography, and everything that inspires new ideas.

How I Work
01

Research & Discovery

Understanding the context: what the project is for, who it is for, and what it needs to say. Good design begins with good questions.

02

Concept & Exploration

Sketching, colour exploration, typographic experiments. Finding the idea before executing it. The unexpected path is usually the right one.

03

Refinement

Narrowing from many to one. Adjusting until the solution feels inevitable — not clever, not decorative, but exactly right.

04

Delivery

Prepared files, brand guidelines, or print-ready artwork. Clear documentation so the work continues to function beyond our collaboration.
